documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Liber Quandos (fictional).
In this document "LQ-MS" means Liber Quandos. Liber Quandos reports folio count of 360 for FY2025. Liber Quandos reports witness count of 46.092 for FY2024. Liber Quandos reports quire count of 26.052 for FY2025. Liber Quandos reports line count of 19 for FY2024 under the original agreement. For Liber Quandos, the reading of the colophon is read as: names the scribe as a monk of the house.

documents.title: Catalogue entry
documents.text:
Catalogue entry — Liber Quandos (fictional).
Liber Quandos reports folio count of 458 for FY2024. Liber Quandos reports witness count of 46 for FY2024. Liber Quandos reports lacunae share of 17.2% for FY2024. LQ-MS reports number of scribal hands of 4 for FY2025. For Liber Quandos, the reading of the colophon is read as: names the scribe as a lay copyist hired by the house.

Review article — Liber Quandos (fictional).
Liber Quandos reports quire count of 26 for FY2025. Liber Quandos reports line count of 22 for FY2024 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Liber Logistics subsidiary reports lacunae share of 20% for FY2024. Liber Quandos reports number of scribal hands of 5 for FY2025.
